function.name: run_reconstructor
function.description: Run one trajectory reconstructor on this window (each reconstructor can be run once; a repeat returns the same result and still counts). Returns its ranked candidate paths with observable diagnostics.

name.description: beam: map beam search (speed + steering, up to 10 candidates); pf: map particle filter (speed + steering, 1 candidate); ep: Elastic Pathing (speed only, up to 10 candidates)

function.name: inspect_candidate
function.description: Detailed diagnostics of one candidate you have already seen: heading consistency, turn matching against the dead-reckoned heading, end position, overlap with the Top-1 of the other reconstructors you have run, and where it diverges from them.

function.name: query_local_graph
function.description: Road junction nearest to a given distance along a candidate you have seen: arrival heading, the exits (relative turn, length, road class, one-way), which exit the candidate took, and the dead-reckoned heading change around that moment.

distance_m.description: distance along the candidate path in metres from the start

function.name: submit_choice
function.description: Final answer: the id of one candidate you have seen. The program outputs that candidate's full trajectory.
